title.narrative: Organizaciones indígenas chiquitanas, apuestan por un desarrollo diferente

description.narrative: The project focuses on the Indigenous Territories of Monte Verde and Lomerío in the Bolivian Chiquitanía in order to strengthen the self-determination and climate resilience of indigenous organizations, with a special focus on women and youth, so that they can fully exercise their Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights through comprehensive territorial management and advocacy on public policies. The project seeks to transform existing inequalities and create a model of fair, sustainable and participatory development, addressing four lines of work:a) strengthen territorial management and the defense of rights of indigenous organizations.b) improve the economic and organizational capacities of associations of women entrepreneurs, promoting economic autonomy and sustainable use of forests.c) strengthen youth leadership for advocacy policy and public policy on climate justice and local policies.d) institutional strengthening of APCOB. The project will directly benefit 4,881 people and 28 indigenous organizations.
